# AE BOSS Ω — Foundation v2.1

Foundation v2.1 hardens the v2 baseline without removing the existing CEP/AE Studio surface.

- SHA-256 cryptographic hashing for kernel specs, evidence and audit chains.
- Governed executor: preflight → dry-run → approval → lease → apply → readback → verify.
- Idempotency/replay protection.
- Fail-closed policy decisions.
- Evidence integrity and verified completion certificates.
- Tamper-evident audit records.

Production certification still requires real AE execution, crash/recovery, Windows runtime hardening, visual QC and golden-project certification.
